title: HR Dashboard
body:
Running the team. Discipline, promotions, activity and order flow.

You set the standard by what you let slide.

options.label: Infractions
options.title: Infractions
options.content:
`/infraction` with a factual reason. The ladder:

**Warning** first minor issue
**Strike** repeat minor, or one moderate
**Suspension** serious, pending review
**Demotion** sustained underperformance or abuse of rank
**Termination** severe, or repeat strikes

Check history with `/infractions` first. Never issue one while annoyed, and never for someone disagreeing with you.

options.label: Promotions
options.title: Promotions
options.content:
`/promotion` with the new rank and a reason. Pass `role` to grant the Discord role at the same time.

Look at order volume in `/stats`, clean QC history, whether newer designers go to them for help, and no recent infractions.

Promote for what someone does, not how long they've been here.

options.label: Activity Checks
options.title: Activity Checks
options.content:
`/activitycheck` with a role, a duration like `2d`, and what you expect.

`/activityresults` shows exactly who didn't respond. Cross-check `/loa list` before you act, people on approved leave are exempt.

Give at least 48 hours before issuing anything for silence.

options.label: Leave
options.title: Leave
options.content:
Requests land in the LOA channel with Approve and Deny. HR only.

Approve generously. Burnt out designers produce worse work than rested ones and quit sooner.

Deny when someone's walking away mid-order without handing off, or when leave has become permanent. `/loa list` shows who's out.

options.label: Order Flow
options.title: Order Flow
options.content:
`/status post` places the board, `/updatestatus` edits it in place so the link never changes.

Close a service when its queue is outrunning the designers who can do it. Reopen the moment you can, a closed service is money walking away.

`/queue post` sets up the live queue. It refreshes itself every five minutes.
